units.en: The video you are watching was not filmed or edited by hand.
units.zh: 你正在看的这个视频，不是拍出来的，也不是手工剪出来的。

units.en: draw each scene as a web page,
take a picture of every frame,
and join everything into one film.
units.zh: 再把所有内容拼成一部完整的影片。

source_text: The video you are watching was not filmed or edited by hand. It was built with code. It takes five simple steps: write the script, turn it into a voice, draw each scene as a web page, take a picture of every frame, and join everything into one film.
